newsitem.title: LEBANON: Bank of Lebanon issues CDs worth 93 bln pounds.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Lebanon issues CDs worth 93 bln pounds.

text.p: The Bank of Lebanon said on Thursday it issued 93 billion Lebanese pounds of 60-day certificates of deposit dated June 6 to commercial banks.
The central bank lowered the annual interest rate on the CDs to 12.5 percent from 12.75 a week earlier.
No sales were made in 45-day CDs on which interests were reduced to 11.75 percent from 12 percent.
Last week, the bank sold 60-day certificates worth 83 billion pounds at 12.75 percent annual interest and 45-day CDs worth 16 billion pounds at 12 percent.
